changes.title: Empowered Strike description
changes.text: Empowered Strike's ordinary description now states that its readied bonus lasts 10 turns and another staff zap refreshes it. Its damage and wand-effect factors are unchanged.

changes.title: Arcane Vision description
changes.text: Arcane Vision's ordinary description now includes Transfusion targeting allies and wards hitting surviving targets, and explains that Frost does not trigger it against an already-frozen target. Its effects and duration are unchanged.
